invariants.title: Money is integer cents; every entry balances, adjusting entries included.
Closing and reopening are a person's acts, with a reason, refused to an agent whatever its role.
A closed period's journal is what it was at close; its financials and hand-overs never change afterwards.
A later change to a closed period lands as a correction on the first open day, per account, named.
Adjusting entries are dated in an open period, balance, carry a reason and say each account's kind.
An accrual marked to reverse reverses itself on the first day of the next month.
A close is refused while statement rows in the period are unreviewed or an account does not tie; the rest is listed.
Only the latest close can be reopened.
Every write is a logged command with an actor; refusals are logged too.
